caption: The drawing consists of six renderings of the same decorative ceramic fragment, arranged in two columns and three rows against a cream-colored background. The top left version is an outline sketch in shades of gray, while the top right is a lightly shaded version in beige and tan tones. The middle left features additional shading and brown hues, giving more volume to the fragment, and the middle right adds deeper browns and richer contrast to the decorative circular and zigzag patterns. The bottom left version introduces greenish tones along with brown, giving the fragment a more aged or patinated appearance, and the bottom right rendering maintains these green and brown hues but with slightly darker shading and more pronounced textural details. All six illustrations depict a fragment with circular raised designs and wavy borders, and they are presented against a neutral, untextured background. The artist’s signature, “Amy Caswell,” is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Renderings of Stone (Demo.)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
